title: Cost Concierge: tenant fingerprint-driven recommendation engine
author: Priya Nair
description: Adds 'Cost Concierge' autosuggestion service: an offline/online hybrid recommender that produces tenant-specific batching, cache, and quantization profiles based on lightweight workload fingerprints and live telemetry. This introduces a scoring model, a safety rule engine, and an API surface to return high-confidence recommendations while ensuring latency SLOs and tenant policies are preserved. Exposes Console suggestion panel under Model -> Cost suggestions and a CLI command (rwdctl econ suggest) for on-demand probes. Includes shadow rollout plumbing, an A/B experiment (SUGGESTER-V1 -> V2) for initial traffic, and a feature flag (econ.concierge.enabled) for emergency rollback. Motivation: reduce manual tuning and accelerate safe unit-econ wins by surfacing conservative but effective defaults tuned per-tenant workload shape. Checklist: [x] unit tests; [x] e2e smoke; [x] Console UI; [x] CLI; [x] telemetry metrics; [x] docs; [ ] long-term retention follow-up (ENG-1682). See design in ENG-1620 and customer repro SUP-4398. This PR touches runtime scoring, orchestration, Console, CLI, ops manifests, and adds telemetry/alerts for suggestion impact.
commits: feat(econ): add tenant fingerprint extractor and serialized profile schema
feat(econ): implement offline scorer + safety rule engine and priority queue
feat(console): add Cost Concierge banner and suggestion panel UI with accept/reject flow
feat(cli): rwdctl econ suggest command and CSV output for bulk tenants
chore(ops): helm values for concierge feature flag and canary percentage
test(e2e): add econ_suggester_smoketest and CI job
perf(runtime): integrate lightweight scoring hook into request router (non-blocking)
review_comments: Diego Alvarez: Please ensure suggestions never increase 95p latency for requests tagged with 'slo-critical'. Add regression guard in rules.py - addressed in commit 'feat(econ): add latency guard for slo-critical tenants'.

Samir Patel: Can we guarantee scorer compute is non-blocking on the hot path? The router hook looks synchronous - changed to async enqueue with immediate fallback in 'runtime/router/suggestion_hook.go'.
Maya Thompson: UI needs an explicit 'What changed' diff when a suggestion is accepted so customers can audit. Added ModelCostSuggestions diff view and test coverage.
Priya (author): Responded to comments and added CI e2e to validate no tail-latency regressions during shadow rollout. Shadow rollout configured for 6% traffic by default.
merge_details: Merged via squash merge by Priya Nair. Merge commit: abcdef12. Canary rollout enabled with feature flag econ.concierge.enabled=true for 6% of production tenants; monitoring alerts primed for metric econ.suggester.recommendation_rate and econ.suggester.latency_delta. Ops notified and runbook updated.
release_notes: Introduce Cost Concierge suggestion engine: per-tenant batching/cache/quant profiles; Console UI and rwdctl CLI integration; safe defaults and shadow rollout; initial canary at 6% traffic. Expect unit-econ wins for many request patterns with no latency regressions under safety guards.
rollout_plan: Stage 1: internal canary (dev) 48h; Stage 2: prod canary 6% traffic 72h with metric watch; Stage 3: 25% ramp if stable; Stage 4: global enable behind org opt-in; rollback via econ.concierge.enabled=false or disable in Console.
test_plan: Unit tests added for scorer and rules, e2e smoke covers accept/reject flow, perf-regression-check compares 95p latency before/after in staging; manual verification steps included in docs/console/cost-concierge.md
notes: This PR intentionally keeps suggestions conservative for the first release (no automatic auto-apply). Follow-up tickets: ENG-1682 (long-term metrics retention), ENG-1620. Customer follow-up SUP-4398 scheduled after canary.
risk_assessment: Low-medium: scoring runs asynchronously with immediate safe fallback; safety rules prevent changes that violate SLOs; storage migration is additive; feature flag present for emergency disable.
